name: Hoi Yen Dieu Tri
nameVi: Đại lễ Hội Yến Diêu Trì Cung
summary: The Mother Goddess rite at the Holy See on lunar 15 and 16 of the eighth month. In 2026 that was 25 and 26 September. On the 25th the church notice prints 0:00, 12:00 at Báo Ân Từ, 16:00 at Giáo Tông Đường, an 18:30 flower procession, and the great rite at 22:00. On the 26th, a children’s blessing at 6:00 and gifts at 7:30. The notice counts 105 offering stalls around Báo Ân Từ. The next solar date and the fee are check on arrival.
when: Lunar 15 and 16 of the eighth month. In 2026, 25 and 26 September. Next solar date: check on arrival.
